standard_prerequisites.name: Faithful flatness of the completion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, the lemma that the completion of a Noetherian local ring is faithfully flat over it
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the base change to the completion flat, so that regularity descends.

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent of regularity along a flat morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, the lemma descending regularity of local rings along a flat local homomorphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the first assertion and one direction of the second.

standard_prerequisites.name: Isomorphism of the complete local rings at the points of the closed fibres
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that the morphism to the base change induces an isomorphism on completions at points over the closed point
standard_prerequisites.use: Combined with the criterion for regularity through completion, gives the equivalence in the second assertion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Characterization of regularity through closed points and base change of properness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Properties, the characterization of regular schemes by the local rings at closed points, and Morphisms, the stability of properness under base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the third assertion for a proper morphism.

core_obligations: First two assertions (proof lines 3000-3012): faithful flatness of the completion makes the base change flat, so regularity descends by the flat descent lemma, which gives the first assertion; the isomorphism of completions at points of the closed fibres together with the criterion for regularity through completion gives the equivalence of the second assertion for points of the closed fibre.

Third assertion (proof lines 3012-3026): if the morphism is proper then its base change is proper, and every closed point of both schemes lies in the closed fibre; the characterization of regularity through closed points then shows that the source is regular exactly when the base change is.
proof_roadmap: Use flatness of the base change to descend regularity.
Compare completions at closed fibre points for the equivalence.
Use properness to reduce the third assertion to closed points.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves three statements comparing regularity of the local rings of a locally finite type scheme over a Noetherian local ring with those of its base change to the completion: one implication holds always, the two conditions are equivalent at points of the closed fibre, and for a proper morphism the two schemes are simultaneously regular (statement lines 2996-3010). The proof (proof lines 3011-3026) descends regularity along the flat base change, compares complete local rings, and uses properness to restrict to closed points. H3: three assertions from three distinct inputs.
